payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all six possible dice outcomes (1..6), compare absolute differences to determine winner/draw, and count wins, draws, losses.
payload.rationale: The solution is a simple brute-force loop over a tiny state space without pruning or specialized enumeration. It does not use branch and bound, bitmasks, graph traversal, or permutation generation. Among the candidates, backtracking most generically captures exhaustive search, though here the loop lacks recursive exploration.
